name: languette
description: A deterministic check against risky actions by coding agents: fail-closed PreToolUse guards for recursive rm, git footguns, deleting a branch an open PR is stacked on, and costly commands the repo says to ask about first.

no_git_footguns.title: Block git footguns
no_git_footguns.description: Deny blanket staging (git add -A), stash pop/drop, force pushes, discarding checkouts and git branch -D. Leave on unless you want these git commands through unchecked.

no_rm_tree.title: Block recursive rm
no_rm_tree.description: Deny recursive rm and find -delete outside scratch areas and generated directories. Leave on unless you want recursive deletes through unchecked.

no_delete_stacked_base.title: Block deleting a stacked base branch
no_delete_stacked_base.description: Deny deleting a remote branch that an open pull request is based on or headed from. Leave on unless you want remote branch deletions through unchecked.

ask_first.title: Ask before costly commands
ask_first.description: Deny a command the repo lists in .languette/ask-first.json until the user approves that one run through AskUserQuestion. Leave on unless you want those commands through unasked.

issue_door.title: One issue create, transfer or delete per turn
issue_door.description: Deny a second GitHub issue create, transfer or delete in the same human turn, and any inside a loop or xargs. Leave on unless you want issue creates, transfers and deletes through unchecked.
